methods.name: Correlation weighted network (CoWNet)
methods.summary: CoWNet is an end-to-end semantic segmentation network consisting of an encoder (ResNet101), a Correlation Weighted Module (CoW) to adaptively adjust the receptive field based on object size, and a Feature Fusion Module (FFM) to combine semantic context and local boundary cues for precise segmentation.
methods.source: Dongbin Yin, Baizhong Zhang, Jingwen Yan, Yu Luo, Teng Zhou, Jing Qin
methods.verbatim: Therefore, we propose a correlation weighted network (CoWNet) to precisely segment the hazard by concentrating on the negative impact of irregular contour and arbitrary scope.

availability.author_statement: Data will be made available on request.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is referenced and linked to a public repository. The custom code for the CoWNet method is not provided or linked.
